title: Archipelago generator rules
description: Composition, pools and ranges of the seeded archipelago generator (D-053, MECHANICS §10, CONTENT §9). The content loader also checks that the ranges are satisfiable.

count.description: How many times the entry appears per archipelago (fertility: islands carrying the tag; deposit: slots).

size.description: Land extent in tiles (the island is about size x size; at least 8). A skerry covers size to 3/4 size^2 tiles (2-8).

rock.description: Resource rock: mountain and coast only, no fertility.

scenic.description: Skerry (D-058): rock with a grass or sand top, no sites, fertilities or deposits, not settleable, no name; land for sea routing only and not counted toward the islands or the buildable area.

count.description: Islands of the class per archipelago.

shape.description: Shape parameters (D-058); a resource rock uses zeros.

arms.description: Arms of the skeleton besides the trunk (0-3).

plain.description: Side in tiles of the guaranteed contiguous plain of grass/forest (0: none; at most size/3).

levels.description: Highest terrace level of the land (0-2; visual only).

islets.description: Islets (decor rocks and sand bars) per island (0-8).

target.description: Buildable tiles (coast, grass, forest) of the whole archipelago.

tolerance.description: Allowed relative deviation from the target (0.1 = ±10 %).

min.description: Minimum gap in tiles between the grids of any two islands (skerries excepted).

nearest_max.description: Maximum gap in tiles from every island to its nearest neighbour (skerries excepted).

strait_min.description: Minimum water in tiles between the land of any two islands, skerries included (D-058).

void_max.description: Maximum distance in tiles from any sea point inside the islands' convex hull to the nearest land (D-058).

terrain.description: Terrain the island must have (forest, grass).

deposits.description: Deposit kinds the island must have.

fertilities_any.description: The island has at least one of these fertilities (empty: no rule).
